technique_name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Shortcut Modification
ai_context: Windows compatibility shim database files (msimain.sdb and sysmain.sdb) were silently installed and registered in the registry, which can cause certain applications to behave differently each time they run.
Rundll32.exe loaded a Windows compatibility DLL and a separate tool silently installed shim database files while writing related entries to the registry.
